reason: The named lab and a report per batch is the exact thing I check before buying, and 200 mg elemental with no oxide is a real dose. At $24.99 I would try one box, but at $29.99 I would probably keep scrolling.
objection: I have never heard of this brand and there are no reviews yet, and I read every review. I also want to open the lab report and see that it is real before I trust it, and $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report did not open on the product page, or the lab was not a real, named lab, I would not buy. A few honest verified reviews, or a lower regular price near $25, would make me buy more than one box.
